q-exact-01.rationale: The Jira artifact has the exact requested issue key and is the canonical record.

q-exact-02.rationale: The pull request has the exact repository and pull-request identifier.

q-exact-03.rationale: The commit artifact has the exact requested short hash.

q-exact-04.rationale: The Slack artifact has the exact stable thread source identifier.

q-exact-05.rationale: The Confluence artifact has the exact space and page source identifier.

q-paraphrase-01.rationale: The architecture page directly explains how lexical and semantic candidates are blended.
The pull request directly implements reciprocal rank fusion for keyword and vector results.
The commit supplies related deterministic tie-breaking detail but not the semantic blend itself.

q-paraphrase-02.rationale: The visibility model directly defines which connector evidence may be returned.
The issue directly describes the stale-access bug and the query-time mitigation.
The Jira issue provides substantial supporting evidence about authorization cache invalidation.
The Slack thread records the reproduction and agreed visibility filtering mitigation.

q-paraphrase-03.rationale: The pull request directly explains committed watermarks and idempotent replay after a crash.
The connector update confirms that durable cursor resume is deployed.

q-paraphrase-04.rationale: The Slack thread directly records the decision to preserve hyphenated Jira keys.
The commit directly implements identifier-aware Slack normalization.

q-paraphrase-05.rationale: The Jira issue directly specifies bounded typo correction after an ordinary-word zero-result query.

q-status-01.rationale: The project update directly states the 35 percent cohort and both pause conditions.
The release thread is the decision record for holding at 35 percent.
The Jira issue provides substantial context for the security gate blocking expansion.

q-status-02.rationale: The canonical issue says the backfill is 82 percent complete and not finished.
The later connector checkpoint repeats the 82 percent status and remaining UTF-8 cleanup.

q-status-03.rationale: The project update directly identifies Security Platform approval as the sole remaining blocker.
The launch-readiness issue is the canonical tracker for the blocking sign-off.
The release discussion corroborates the security gate and rollout pause.

q-status-04.rationale: The monitoring issue directly reports the restored 445 ms P95 after mitigation.
The retrieval checkpoint reports P95 of 445 ms and the ongoing monitoring state.
The project update gives the related sub-500-ms gate but not the latest measurement.

q-status-05.rationale: The commit states that the Confluence ACL guard shipped and is enabled.
The connector checkpoint independently confirms the sync shipped and is enabled.

q-slack-01.rationale: This is the requested Slack decision thread about treating Jira keys as one token.
The implementation commit materially supports the thread decision.

q-slack-02.rationale: This is the requested release-channel conversation that fixed the cohort at 35 percent.
The project update corroborates the decision but is not the requested conversation.

q-slack-03.rationale: The requested Slack thread names the reproducer and records the agreed mitigation.
The linked issue materially supports the mitigation but is not the requested thread.

q-slack-04.rationale: The requested search-channel thread records the title-only relevance decision.
The rubric codifies the Slack decision but is not the conversation itself.

q-slack-05.rationale: The requested release-channel thread records the 10:00 UTC approval window.
The runbook references the recorded release window but does not state the time.

q-confluence-01.rationale: The requested architecture page directly explains RRF and the k=60 constant.
The pull request implements the design but is not the requested documentation page.

q-confluence-02.rationale: The evaluation rubric directly documents relevance grades 0 through 3.
The Slack thread discusses one grading constraint but not the complete scale.

q-confluence-03.rationale: The ACL and visibility page directly defines all three requested visibility states.

q-confluence-04.rationale: The rollout and rollback runbook directly contains the requested checklist.
The release thread points operators to the checklist but does not enumerate it.

q-confluence-05.rationale: The evaluation rubric directly defines citation correctness using source identifiers and URLs.
